r0078: III.  APPLICATION OF ARTICLE 41 OF THE CONVENTION
r0080: “If the Court finds that there has been a violation of the Convention or the Protocols thereto, and if the internal law of the High Contracting Party concerned allows only partial reparation to be made, the Court shall, if necessary, afford just satisfaction to the injured party.”
r0082: 48.  The applicant claimed, firstly, compensation for the pecuniary damage sustained in respect of bailiff’s fees, but left it to the Court to assess the amount on the basis of the documents submitted during the proceedings. He further claimed ITL 1,332,700, corresponding to the service charges owed by the tenant, together with the rent unpaid by the tenant and the difference between the rent he had received and the rent he could have obtained at market rates. He also claimed ITL 399,999 for the costs of the proceedings concerning the payment order for the service charges.
r0083: 49.  The Government considered that there was no causal link whatsoever between the damage claimed and the alleged violations of the Convention.
r0084: 50.  The Court considers that the costs of the eviction proceedings should be reimbursed (see Immobiliare Saffi, cited above, § 79): on the basis of the documents in its possession, it awards the sum of ITL 330,000 under that head.
r0085: As regards the service charges and unpaid rent, which the applicant did not even quantify, the Court considers, given that he can recover them from the tenant, that there is no reason to award the applicant any sum under that head.
r0086: As regards the loss of rental income, the Court reiterates that under Rule 60 of the Rules of Court the applicant must submit itemised particulars of his claims, together with the relevant supporting documents, “failing which the Chamber may reject the claim in whole or in part”. Since the applicant failed to do so, the Court decides to make no award under this head.
r0087: As to the costs of the proceedings concerning the payment order, the Court considers, like the Government, that they have no direct causal link with the violations found.
